# Aktiechefens case: "Ser intressanta ut – värderingarna har kommit ner"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-11-12  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a morning pre-open episode (Dagen med DI). It covers Q3 reports, including Meko, which fell about 8% on negative organic growth even though debt came down. It also discusses the upcoming Anthropic IPO, which the guest expects to start strongly. The guest, Carl, an equity strategist from DNB Carnegie, calls the recent AI/data-center-driven drop in ABB and Atlas Copco a buyable pullback, likes the engineering sector broadly on lower valuations and rising earnings expectations, and also points to Ericsson and the serial acquirer Sdiptech.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ABB — ABB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

The guest calls the AI-driven post-report drop a buyable pullback. Results are strong and earnings expectations are intact.

#### Reasoning

The guest (DNB Carnegie) says ABB's recent and prior quarterly results give no reason for concern. He sees the selloff as short-term uncertainty about how long AI/data-center investment will last, which he expects to pass as it did earlier this year. Valuations are high but have come down. Industrial conditions are improving and engineering-sector earnings expectations are rising.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI/data-center investment cycle proves to be ending
- if earnings expectations for the coming years are cut materially
- if the industrial recovery stalls

> *"Då ser jag nedgången som en köpvärd rekyl."*

---

### 🟢 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Pressured along with ABB on AI worries. The guest sees a buying opportunity because valuations are lower and earnings are improving.

#### Reasoning

The guest groups Atlas Copco with ABB. Company-specific nervousness about demand gave investors a chance to look at the stock again. Share prices are down while earnings estimates have risen, and he sees good sector conditions for engineering companies to keep developing.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-center demand weakens structurally
- if the industrial cycle turns down
- if earnings estimates are revised down

> *"Även om värderingarna är höga, så har man fått ett litet köpläge."*

---

### 🟢 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Pressured by the SpaceX mobile-operator threat. The guest sees potential in a recovery and the defence theme.

#### Reasoning

The guest thinks the SpaceX threat to the US operator market lies far in the future, so the recent weakness creates potential. He also expects defence to become increasingly relevant for Ericsson, something the market rarely discusses.

#### Sell Triggers

- if SpaceX moves quickly into US mobile operator services
- if defence-related opportunities fail to show up

> *"Där tror jag att det finns mer potential"*

---

### 🟠 SDIP-B — Sdiptech | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

The guest names this small serial acquirer as an example of improving earnings growth among smaller companies.

#### Reasoning

The guest notes that earnings growth below the large caps is starting to look good and calls Sdiptech a good example that is starting to look lively. The view is positive but brief, with no explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if earnings growth fails to materialise in coming reports

> *"Så jag tycker den här lilla serieförvärvaren Estiptec är ett sådant gott exempel. som börjar se pigg ut."*

---

### 🟠 MEKO — Meko | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Organic growth was -3% and the stock is indicated down 8%. Debt is falling. Ulf was earlier positive but says the company now has to prove itself.

#### Reasoning

Ulf (host or commentator) was positive on Meko the previous week. He thinks an 8% drop is a lot for this report, but says the restructuring has not paid off yet and the company still has the burden of proof. Positives are deleveraging, strong cash flow and new private-label spare parts for older cars. The negative is organic growth, which was worse in Q3 than in H1.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth stays negative
- if the private-label launches fail to lift sales
- if deleveraging stalls

> *"de har bevisbördan på sig och idag skingrade de inte molnen riktigt"*

---

### 🟠 SYNSAM — Synsam | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

The host expects Synsam to rise on today's report.

#### Reasoning

In the pre-open comments, the host says Synsam should rise overall on its report. The view is brief and gives no further detail.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the market reacts negatively to the report

> *"Men den bör överlag stiga, synsamt tycker jag"*
